title: The Same L-Carnitine Dose Costs $0.11 or $3.46 a Day
description: We priced 34 L-carnitine listings on Amazon and held the dose constant at the 2 g the recovery trials used. Cheapest works out at $39 a year. Dearest at $1,263. Same compound, same dose. Enter the price, mg and count from your bottle and see where it lands. #LCarnitine #Supplements #SupplementFacts #FuelnFitHub
